name: Kokolet Luxury
summary: A premium online store connecting product discovery, checkout and repeat purchases.
challenge: Create an online flagship that felt as considered as the products, while keeping browsing and repeat purchasing simple.
solution: We designed an editorial storefront and connected the catalogue, checkout and order operations behind it.

features.title: Editorial catalogue
features.text: Collections and product pages designed to present products the way the brand does in store.

features.title: Secure checkout
features.text: A short checkout flow with online payments.

features.title: Loyalty journey
features.text: Account features that encourage customers to come back.

features.title: Order operations
features.text: Admin tools to manage orders, stock and fulfilment.

name: Colala Mall
summary: A marketplace connecting buyers, sellers, payments and fulfilment in one platform.
challenge: Make seller onboarding and product discovery simple while supporting a growing catalogue.
solution: We delivered a modular marketplace with clear seller operations and a transaction flow that can grow with the platform.

features.title: Seller onboarding
features.text: Sign-up, store setup and product listing for sellers.

features.title: Product discovery
features.text: Search, categories and filters for buyers.

features.title: Payments
features.text: Checkout and payment handling between buyers and sellers.

features.title: Order management
features.text: Order tracking and fulfilment tools for sellers and admins.

name: BillsPro
summary: A mobile app bringing bill payments, a wallet and virtual cards into one product.
challenge: Combine several payment actions in one app without overwhelming customers.
solution: We built a mobile-first app with clear transaction flows, status visibility and admin controls behind it.

features.title: Bill payments
features.text: Guided flows for paying everyday bills.

features.title: Virtual cards
features.text: Card creation and management inside the app.

features.title: Transaction monitoring
features.text: Admin views to track and support transactions.
